node.title: Re^3: How to read the input directory from command line arguments using perl?
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
You already have all the pieces that you need:

  1. In your root node you show how you get the command line arguments.
  2. [bart] showed you how to
    1. get the pathname of the project.txt file using [doc://File::Basename],
    2. parse the value out of the REVISION_LOCATION: line, and
    3. turn that filename from relative to absolute using [doc://File::Spec]'s rel2abs, using the pathname of project.txt as the base.

If you're unsure on how to open the project.txt file instead of using the magic while(<>) that [bart] used, please see [doc://perlintro#Files-and-I/O|"Files and I/O" in perlintro].

Updated wording slightly.
